jobs_results.description:
About the job:

We are looking for a detail-oriented and responsible Accounts Executive to manage day-to-day accounting activities and support the finance department. The candidate will be responsible for maintaining accurate financial records, handling invoices and payments, managing GST-related activities, bank reconciliation, and ensuring proper accounting documentation.



Key Responsibilities:



1. Maintain day-to-day accounting transactions in Tally / ERP software.

2. Prepare and maintain sales invoices, purchase entries, debit notes and credit notes.

3. Handle Accounts Payable and Accounts Receivable.

4. Maintain records of customer outstanding payments and supplier payments.

5. Perform regular bank reconciliation and cash reconciliation.

6. Prepare and maintain GST-related records, including purchase and sales data.

7. Assist in the preparation and filing of GST returns and other statutory compliance documents.

8. Verify and process vendor bills, employee expenses and payment requests.

9. Maintain proper records of petty cash and company expenses.

10. Coordinate with vendors, customers, banks and internal departments regarding accounts-related matters.

11. Assist in preparing monthly financial reports and management reports.

12. Maintain proper documentation and filing of invoices, vouchers and other financial records.

13. Support the preparation of data required for audits and statutory compliance.

14. Monitor outstanding payments and follow up with customers where required.

15. Assist management with financial data, reports and other accounting requirements.

16. Ensure accuracy, confidentiality and proper maintenance of all financial records.



Key Competencies:



1. Accuracy and attention to detail

2. Financial and numerical skills

3. Time management

4. Problem-solving ability

5. Confidentiality and integrity

6. Team coordination

7. Strong organisational skills

jobs_results.title: Associate Accountant (CA Freshers)
jobs_results.description:
About BDO India

BDO is a global network of professional services firms with a presence in over 166 countries, revenue of over USD 14 billion, and experience of over 60 years. Its a leading service provider for the mid-markets with client service at its heart.

BDO India Services Private Limited (or ‘BDO India’) is the India member firm of BDO International. BDO India offers strategic, operational, accounting and tax, and regulatory advisory & assistance for both domestic and international organizations across a range of industries. BDO India is led by more than 300+ Partners & Directors with a team of over 10,000 professionals operating across 14 cities and 20 offices. We expect to grow sizably in the coming 3-5 years, adding various dimensions to our business and multiplying and increasing the current team size multi-fold.




The Opportunity

We are looking for a newly qualified Chartered Accountant to join our Finance & Accounting team. The role will provide exposure to financial accounting, taxation and statutory compliance, audit coordination, reconciliations, and MIS reporting. The ideal candidate should have strong accounting fundamentals, analytical ability, and a keen eye for detail.




Key Responsibilities

Financial Accounting

Assist in preparing and finalizing monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements in accordance with applicable Indian Accounting Standards (Ind AS).Support month-end and year-end closing activities.Ensure accuracy and completeness of accounting records and financial information.


Taxation & Compliance

Assist in ensuring timely compliance with applicable statutory and regulatory requirements.Support preparation and filing of GST, TDS, and Income Tax returns.Assist in maintaining tax records and supporting documentation.


Audits

Support internal, statutory, and tax audits.Coordinate with external auditors and provide required schedules, documents, and supporting information.Assist in addressing audit queries and closing audit requirements.


Reconciliations

Perform regular bank, vendor, and customer ledger reconciliations.Identify discrepancies and coordinate with relevant stakeholders for timely resolution.Ensure reconciliation statements and supporting documentation are properly maintained.


MIS Reporting

Prepare accurate and timely MIS reports for management review.Assist in variance analysis against budgets, forecasts, and prior-period results.Highlight significant variances and provide relevant insights to support decision-making.


Qualifications:

CA Fresher / Newly Qualified Chartered Accountant.Strong academic and accounting fundamentals.Candidates with relevant articleship exposure in financial accounting, taxation, audit, and compliance will be preferred.Should demonstrate a willingness to learn and take ownership of assigned responsibilities.Strong understanding of accounting principles and financial reporting.Basic knowledge of Ind AS, GST, TDS, and Income Tax.Strong analytical and numerical skills.Good command of MS Excel and accounting/ERP systems.High attention to detail and accuracy.Ability to work independently as well as collaborate with internal and external stakeholders.
